versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support end-to-end com- munication protection Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to assign a unique data ID to a specific communication path (in the context of an ECU) and also the selection of a E2E Profile ID shall be supported. Rationale: Adding these properties will allow protected end-to-end communication between SW components. Use Case: The OEM or supplier need to be able to specify protected end-to-end communication between SW components. Dependencies: [RS_SWCT_00010] Supporting Material: The details of the end-to-end protection in AUTOSAR are described in [6]
